summary: Seagate Technology Holdings plc filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary issued a redemption notice for its 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2028. Holders may exchange notes for ordinary shares at a current rate of 12.1363 shares per $1,000 principal until September 3, 2026; otherwise notes will be redeemed for cash at principal plus accrued interest on September 8, 2026. This is a routine debt redemption pursuant to the indenture terms, not a special-situation event. The exchange rate will adjust on June 25, 2026 due to a previously announced dividend. No strategic restructuring, acquisition, or activist campaign is involved.
